articles_author_source_unique_idx.name: articles_author_source_unique_idx
articles_author_source_unique_idx.where: "articles"."source_article_id" IS NOT NULL AND "articles"."deleted_at" IS NULL

space_participations_join_path_fk_check.name: space_participations_join_path_fk_check
space_participations_join_path_fk_check.value:
("space_participations"."join_path" = 'INVITATION' AND "space_participations"."invitation_id" IS NOT NULL AND "space_participations"."code_request_id" IS NULL)
     OR ("space_participations"."join_path" = 'CODE' AND "space_participations"."code_request_id" IS NOT NULL AND "space_participations"."invitation_id" IS NULL)
     OR ("space_participations"."join_path" IS NULL AND "space_participations"."invitation_id" IS NULL AND "space_participations"."code_request_id" IS NULL)

thoughts_writing_source_unique_idx.name: thoughts_writing_source_unique_idx
thoughts_writing_source_unique_idx.where: "thoughts"."source_article_id" IS NOT NULL AND "thoughts"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND ("thoughts"."status" = 'PRELIMINARY' OR "thoughts"."migrated_from_article_id" IS NOT NULL)
